notes: Global Economic Prospects and the Developing Countries 1992. Table 1-6 Real GDP growth rates of developing countries, 1980-2000 (column 1992; 1991 is an estimate, 1990-2000 a decade average), page 18 of https://documents.worldbank.org/curated/en/875251468762297323/pdf/Global-economic-prospects-and-the-developing-countries-1992.pdf, a scanned report. Read by OCR: tesseract at 400 dpi agrees with the PDF text layer; the February 1992 draft of the same table (report 10493) prints the same 1992 values for Sub-Saharan Africa, East Asia, South Asia and Latin America. Table note: Former Soviet Union not included in totals. 1987 prices and exchange rates. Values as printed (1 decimal); aggregates use the World Bank grouping and 1987 weights of that edition. Published month: World Bank announcement of the report, 16 April 1992 (documents.worldbank.org). Not captured: next-year (1993) forecasts (the table has none); World, High-income countries and countries (no annual forecast table); "Eastern Europe" (no later counterpart) is not captured.
